sentences.en: Having a bad cold, he was absent from school today.
sentences.zh: 患重感冒，他今天没来上学。

sentences.en: The boy was absent from school yesterday because of illness.
sentences.zh: 因为生病，那个男孩昨天没来上学。

sentences.en: The boy has been absent from school for eight days.
sentences.zh: 那男孩已经连续八天没来上学了。

senses.zh: 缺席的，不在场的，缺乏的
